column1: # Mission items and mission keepsakes, as the missions session asked (its needs.json and economy.json
# collectibles). Mission items are bound to their mission and vanish when it ends; creatures (cat, frog, ninken,
# stray pet) are followers, not items. Nine mission needs reuse items that already exist: bouquet, lamp_oil,
# practice_kunai, stolen_goods, tea_leaves, herb (healing_herb), groceries (grocery_order), parcel (quest_parcel),
# sealed_letter (quest_letter). Keepsakes are the first A grade or better on their mission.
